blockBaselineElapsed: sqrt(BaselineBefore.Nanoseconds * BaselineAfter.Nanoseconds), computed as a geometric mean.
blockBaselineAllocation: Geometric mean of BaselineBefore.Bytes and BaselineAfter.Bytes.
baselineElapsedControl: abs(BaselineAfter.Nanoseconds - BaselineBefore.Nanoseconds) <= 0.1 * BaselineBefore.Nanoseconds, for every block and parameter.
aggregate: Geometric mean of seven candidate/block-baseline ratios, separately per parameter and metric.
directionalBlock: Candidate/block-baseline ratio strictly less than one for the same qualifying metric.
primary: Parameter16: aggregate elapsed ratio <=0.95 and at least6 elapsed directional blocks, OR aggregate allocation ratio <=0.95 and at least6 allocation directional blocks.
nonregression: Every parameter: aggregate elapsed ratio <=1.05 and aggregate allocation ratio <=1.01.
zeroAllocationDenominator: Zero candidate and zero block baseline is neutral ratio1. Positive candidate over zero baseline is positive infinity and fails allocation nonregression. Zero candidate over positive baseline is ratio0.
undefinedMixedZeroAndInfinity: Never silently average: comparison is infrastructure-inconclusive and no retry is permitted.
identityGeometricMean: Exactly identical inputs retain their exact value, preventing floating-point artifacts from manufacturing directional improvement.
anyControlFailure: Inconclusive even if other apparent reductions are material.
incompleteOrFailedExecution: Infrastructure-inconclusive; retain every observation, close Original under the no-retry clause, and do not compare Default.
